transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
My mind just won’t stay on one thing anymore. At the bench, I’ll start with a customer email, then notice a saw mark, hear something outside, and suddenly I’ve lost track of the whole work order.
Did you have similar difficulties with focus and attention when you were a child?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having that kind of problem as a kid.
Aside from the trouble concentrating, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless lately?
Yeah. The last couple weeks, I wake up feeling heavy and hollow, like the shine has gone out of everything. I’ve cried sitting in my truck before opening the shop.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or needed much less sleep than usual?
Yeah. For a while I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours, but I’d wake up clear-headed and excited to start cutting stones or putting new designs online before sunrise.
During these past couple of weeks, have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or feeling like you would be better off dead?
Yeah... I keep thinking my family and my clients would be better off if I wasn’t around. I don’t have a plan to do anything, but it comes up a lot, and it scares me.
Are you still able to get some work and daily tasks done, or has it become completely impossible to manage your everyday responsibilities?

I can do some things, but it’s gotten pretty bad. I missed a major custom delivery, and my shop records got so disorganized that I had to stop taking new work for now. My family’s been checking on me more too—they’re worried because I’m not keeping up with my usual routines.
Have you or anyone close to you noticed that your physical movements or speech have slowed down noticeably?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed my speech or movements being slower, and nobody’s said anything to me about that.
Have you been struggling with intense feelings of worthlessness or blaming yourself excessively for things?
Yeah. I keep going over all the promises I messed up with clients and telling myself I’m a fraud. I feel like I embarrassed my family over that one award, and I can’t seem to let it go.
Have you been experiencing constant fatigue or a significant lack of energy lately?
Yeah. My arms feel like lead when I’m at the bench. Even polishing a setting or carrying a tray of stones wipes me out, and a full night off doesn’t really fix it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things or hobbies that you normally enjoy doing?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed losing interest in anything in particular.
